item.title: The Part of Software Engineering AI Cannot Replace
item.content:encoded: AI replaced the code-writing part of software engineering, but it did not replace the engineering itself. This post explores what is left when code generation is instant. Judgment, system thinking, and the ability to audit what you did not write.
